scientific_distinctions.HINDSIGHT_TEACHER: 100pct strict on selected only by future-known optimal interval scheduling; not deployable
scientific_distinctions.R11_V5_ELIGIBILITY: original first observed 250ms with >15s quote-gap new 300s warmup, one of many final v5 gates; other gates not certified
scientific_distinctions.CAUSAL_STUDENT: per-month full-population LightGBM six boosting rounds per side; individual month trained and evaluated same month. NO OOS, NO good entry policy, zero strict economically eligible trades.
scientific_distinctions.COST_STRESS: Post-hoc adding cents to net under original exits; not a new fill or latency-sensitive bar replay
scientific_distinctions.DATA_PRESERVATION: all raw ticks already in PRIMARY, full original teacher labels rebuilt exact sha and stored lossless, per-month 11 oracle traces and day/week, per-month both trained models and complete PGOOD/PBAD/PNEUT scores lossless, seven student policy traces and day/week; complete event-graph NPY large and regenerable from source and hash, not copied to Drive.
